name: Sherebiah
bio: Sherebiah, a Levite of understanding, was brought to Ezra at Casiphia along with his sons and brothers, eighteen in all, to serve as a minister for the house of God since no Levites had joined the returning exiles. Ezra entrusted him, along with Hashabiah and ten others, with guarding the temple's silver, gold, and vessels on the journey to Jerusalem (Ezra 8:15-19, 24). He later helped explain the Law to the people when Ezra read it publicly after the wall's completion (Nehemiah 8:7). He also helped lead the Levites in the long prayer of confession recounting Israel's history, offered when the people fasted and repented after the Feast of Tabernacles, which closed with the leaders sealing a written covenant to obey God's law (Nehemiah 9:4-38).
